Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

careless adjective

also negligent, carelessness, negligence, indifferent

classical

Traupman 154, 156

neglegēns, neglegentis

careless, negligent, indifferent

Traupman spells it neglig-; Lewis & Short prefers negleg-.

Other words

  • incūriōsus, incūriōsa, incūriōsum — careless, unconcerned

    also used · classical · Plin. Ep. 8.20.1 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 150

    Lewis & Short: post-Augustan.

  • neglegentia, neglegentiae f. — carelessness, negligence

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.28 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 156

  • incūria, incūriae f. — carelessness, neglect

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Prov. Cons. 3 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 150, 156

See also diligent.
